ns2:section.sectionText: Seats are reserved for LAS Access and Achievement Program students, specifically for Undeclared students until December 1, and then seats will open for EOP and PAP students within the college of Liberal Arts and Sciences. If you do not meet this requirement, please contact the Access and Achievement Program Office in 112 English Building to be placed on the waiting list.
